title: Microsoft Edge: organise and merge PDF files in the built-in PDF reader
summary: The briefing accurately reports the roadmap's planned PDF editing and merging capability. The updated Edge policy reference still does not document PdfOrganizeAndMergeEnabled, and targeted searches did not establish a feature default, licence requirement or protection behaviour.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Open questions
claims.claim: Microsoft has not documented whether the new PDF produced by this feature retains protection from its source files.
claims.quote: Searched: "Microsoft Edge" "merge" "PDF" "protected"; Microsoft Edge organize merge PDF files licensing price meter protection sensitivity labels. Opened PDF reader in Microsoft Edge; read Purview PDF-support excerpts; none describe protection on Edge merged output.

claims.claim: Neither the roadmap nor the Edge PDF reader page says how organising or merging treats protected PDFs.
claims.quote: Searched: "Microsoft Edge" "merge" "PDF" "protected". Read roadmap and https://learn.microsoft.com/deployedge/microsoft-edge-pdf in full; both omit organising or merging protected PDFs. Returned protection excerpts concern viewing PDFs or creating PDFs in Office, not this feature.

claims.claim: The Edge policy reference has no PdfOrganizeAndMergeEnabled page or documented UI or automation setting for that policy.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not documented whether PdfOrganizeAndMergeEnabled applies per device or per user.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not documented exactly what disabling PdfOrganizeAndMergeEnabled prevents.
